DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.HideCombatantN: When enabled, monster and NPC names are replaced for players in the combat tracker.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.ReplacementNam: The name shown to players in the combat tracker instead of a monster or NPC name.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.OnlyHostile.Hi: When enabled, friendly and neutral NPCs keep their names. Hostile creatures are still hidden from players.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.GmTransparentF: When enabled, areas outside token vision stay shaded for the DM but the map shows through, and the DM can still see and select all tokens. Players are unaffected.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.TokenAuras.Hin: When enabled, token configuration gains an Auras tab, and Active Effects can push aura settings onto the token from the Changes tab.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.HideHostileAur: When enabled, auras on hostile tokens are only visible to the GM.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.HideBloodiedEf: When enabled, the Bloodied condition is not applied to actors.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.ExtendedEffect: When enabled, Active Effect duration has extended possibilities.
When enabled, GM rolls do not play the dice sound. Roll chat is hidden from players only when the mode is Private GM Roll (private to gamemasters). Public rolls stay visible. Player rolls are unaffected.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.EnhancedStatus: When enabled, custom conditions appear on actor Effects tabs and can apply linked Active Effects.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.TokenTorch.Hin: When enabled, the token HUD gains a flame button to light or extinguish a torch that moves with the token.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.TokenTorchAllo: When enabled, players who own a token can see and use the torch button. When disabled, only the GM sees it.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.TokenTorchLumi: How strong the torch glow looks (0 = soft color only, 1 = very bright). Lower values light the surroundings without washing out the token. Torches illuminate the area but do not provide vision to other tokens.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.EnhancedStatus: Create and edit custom conditions and the Active Effects they apply.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.EnhancedStatusEffects.M: Each condition has a name and a linked Active Effect. Create or edit the effect and add Changes (attribute keys) on it — those are what get applied when the condition is toggled on.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.EnhancedStatusEffects.D: Enable Custom conditions in module settings to configure custom conditions.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.EnhancedStatusEffects.E: Active Effects on this item are templates for Enhanced status effects custom conditions. Do not delete this item.

DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.TokenTorch.ErrNoPermiss: You do not have permission to change this token's light.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.TokenTorch.ErrDimLessTh: Dim range must be greater than or equal to bright range.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.TokenTorch.ErrNeedGM: A GM must be connected to light or extinguish a torch.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.TokenTorch.ErrApplyFail: Failed to update the torch light.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.EndEffect.Title: END EFFECT
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.AttackLimit.Hint: The effect applies to this many distinct attack rolls, then is removed before the next new attack. Re-rolling the same attack does not consume another use.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.DamageLimit.Hint: The effect applies to this many distinct damage rolls, then is removed before the next new damage roll. Re-rolling the same damage does not consume another use.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.ConcentrationLimit.Hint: The effect applies to this many distinct concentration checks, then is removed before the next new concentration check. Re-rolling the same check does not consume another use. Regular saving throws are not counted.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.SaveLimit.Hint: The effect applies to this many distinct saving throws of this ability, then is removed before the next new save. Re-rolling the same save does not consume another use.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.CheckLimit.Hint: The effect applies to this many distinct ability checks of this ability, then is removed before the next new check. Re-rolling the same check does not consume another use.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.SkillLimit.Hint: The effect applies to this many distinct checks of this skill, then is removed before the next new check. Re-rolling the same check does not consume another use.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.Portals.Name: Portals
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.Portals.Hint: When enabled, GMs get a Portals scene control to create and connect portal pads. Tokens that can be moved by the user teleport when stepping onto an enterable linked pad or using its Activate button.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.PortalsBorderC: Color of portal square borders on the canvas. Applies to all portals immediately.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.PortalsBorderW: Thickness of portal square borders in pixels (1–20). Applies to all portals immediately.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Portals.Name: Name
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Portals.DeleteConfirm: Delete portal "{name}"? Its partner (if any) will be unlinked.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Portals.CreateHint: Click or drag on the grid to select portal squares, then Create.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Portals.ConnectHint: Click a grid square to place this portal’s shape (selected cell is the top-left), then Connect.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Portals.NeedSquareGrid: Portals require a square grid on this scene.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Portals.NoUnconnected: There are no unconnected portals to link.

DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Portals.ErrSelectToken: Select a token on this portal first.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Portals.ErrTokenPermiss: You do not have permission to move that token.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Portals.ErrTokenNotOnPo: The selected token is not on this portal.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Portals.ErrNoPartner: This portal has no linked partner.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Portals.ErrSceneMissing: The destination scene no longer exists.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Portals.ErrNeedGM: An active GM is required to teleport across scenes.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.Traps.Name: Traps
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.Traps.Hint: When enabled, GMs get a Traps scene control to paint trap squares. Tokens that move onto or over a trap stop there, post a chat message, and may pause the game, reveal a tile, or run a macro.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.TrapsBorderCol: Color of trap square borders on the canvas (GM only). Applies to all traps immediately.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Settings.TrapsBorderWid: Thickness of trap square borders in pixels (1–20). Applies to all traps immediately.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Traps.Name: Name
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Traps.CreateHint: Click or drag on the grid to select trap squares, then Create trap.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Traps.NeedSquareGrid: Traps require a square grid on this scene.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Traps.ErrCellsRequired: Select at least one grid square.
DM-TOOLKIT-DND5E.Traps.ErrCellOccupied: That grid square already belongs to a trap.
